ticker: Short code under which a stock or ETF is traded (e.g. NVDA, EXS1.DE).
price: Current market price of the asset.
period: Select the time range for which prices and metrics are shown (e.g. 1 year).
return: Percentage change in price over the selected period.
volatility: How much the price fluctuates. Higher values = larger swings.
max_drawdown: Largest decline from a peak during the selected period.
sharpe: Ratio of return to risk; higher is better for risk‑adjusted return.
ter: Annual cost of an ETF. These fees reduce returns.
diversification: How broadly an ETF is spread. More holdings = less single‑stock risk.
benchmark: Reference index used to compare performance (e.g. DAX).
weights: Share of an asset in the total portfolio as a percentage.
rebalancing: Regularly resetting weights, e.g. monthly or yearly.
backtest: Simulation of how your portfolio would have performed historically. Not a guarantee of future results.
assumptions: Assumptions such as annual savings rate or fees that affect the simulation.
add_ticker: Enter the ticker (e.g. NVDA or EXS1.DE) and press Enter or 'Add'.
invalid_ticker: Ticker not found. Check spelling or add exchange suffix (e.g. .DE, .L).
loading: Loading data… (may take a few seconds for many tickers)
